d: Keeta, the international subsidiary of global delivery leader Meituan, is driven by a clear mission: We help people eat better, live better. Building on our parent company's 16 years of technological and operational expertise mastered in China, we are leading a global transformation in food and consumer product delivery. Since our start in 2023, Keeta has focused on creating value for every part of the communities we serve. We provide a reliable experience for consumers, enhance technology and operations for restaurants, and create more earning opportunities and greater safety for courier partners. This commitment to shared progress drives our journey from Hong Kong, China, across the Middle East and into Brazil, with the world ahead.
q: 5+ years of experience in retail/e-commerce fulfillment operations or supply chain management, with hands-on experience building operational systems or SOPs from scratch. Clear understanding of the operational differences between Hypermarket and Dark Store formats.
Proven 3PL management experience — including contract negotiation, SLA design, performance evaluation, capacity planning, and cost analysis. Experience managing 10+ vendors in parallel is preferred.
Data-driven decision-making ability — capable of independently designing KPI frameworks and translating them into executable governance mechanisms (warnings, terminations, penalties, etc.).
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills — able to effectively coordinate with Customer Service, Delivery, Product, and Technology teams to drive closed-loop problem resolution.
Frontline team management experience — background in managing Pickers, Riders, or Drivers at scale with a systematic governance approach, not limited to single-store or small-team scheduling.
Fluent English as a working language — able to communicate independently with merchants, frontline teams, and cross-functional stakeholders.
You'll build the entire Picker fulfillment system from the ground up for a rapidly scaling market — real ownership over strategy, operations, and governance.
You'll work at the intersection of operations, supply chain, and vendor management in a high-growth quick commerce environment.
You'll manage a large-scale 3PL ecosystem and shape the frameworks that define fulfillment quality and cost efficiency across multiple formats.
You'll have direct exposure to cross-functional leadership and the autonomy to design systems that scale across regions.
r: li

Lead the end-to-end Picker strategy and system-building — design and continuously iterate picking SOPs from scratch, including picking standards, operational procedures, exception handling protocols, and quality control checkpoints. Ensure the system is replicable and scalable across Hypermarket and Dark Store formats.
li

Manage the full 3PL partnership lifecycle — from vendor screening and onboarding, to SLA negotiation, pricing analysis, capacity planning, and performance evaluation. Scale to oversee dozens of 3PL partners through a structured, tiered management framework.
li

Build the Picker performance and governance system — design a multi-dimensional KPI framework covering efficiency, quality, on-time rate, and satisfaction. Establish warning mechanisms, rectification processes, termination standards, and penalty/incentive structures, codified into executable operational manuals.
li

Develop and optimize Picker pricing strategies — build a data-driven pricing model based on fulfillment cost structures, market benchmarks, merchant needs, and capacity supply-demand dynamics. Conduct rationality analysis of 3PL quotations to ensure competitive and sustainable pricing.
li

Own the full-chain fulfillment KPI monitoring system — covering the complete journey from order placement → merchant acceptance → item picking → packaging → delivery → completion → after-sales. Track order cancellation rate, on-time rate, stock-out rate, completion rate, refund rate, satisfaction, and complaint rate. Build automated anomaly detection and closed-loop resolution mechanisms.
li

Drive cross-functional collaboration — partner closely with Customer Service and Delivery teams to establish coordination mechanisms, drive root cause analysis of customer complaints, and optimize delivery timeliness and fulfillment efficiency. Conduct regular store visits and frontline research at Hypermarkets and Dark Stores to identify and resolve operational bottlenecks.

d: Jumeirah, a global leader in luxury hospitality and a member of Dubai Holding, operates an exceptional portfolio of 31 properties, including 33 signature F&B restaurants, across the Middle East, Europe, Asia and Africa. In 1999, Jumeirah changed the face of luxury hospitality with the opening of the iconic Jumeirah Burj Al Arab and the brand is now renowned worldwide for its distinguished beachfront resorts, esteemed city hotels and luxury residences. From the contemporary Maldivian island paradise at Jumeirah Olhahali Island to the art-inspired Jumeirah Capri Palace in Italy and the modern twist on a British classic at Jumeirah Carlton Tower in London, the brand has become synonymous with warm and generous service and the ability to craft distinctive and purposeful experiences that bring joy to guests from across the world.

Jumeirah Messilah Beach is uniquely located in a secluded area with easy access to Kuwait’s Central Business District, airport, and major Kuwait attractions. The resort features 316 rooms and suites, 79 residential suites, and 10 villas totalling 405 units. The beachfront hotel features an impressive array of exceptional dining destinations, including the Garden Café all-day dining restaurant, Pepper Steakhouse, Olio Trattoria Italiana, Mint Café, and The Lobby Lounge for a relaxing afternoon tea.

Setting new standards for holistic relaxation and luxurious comfort, the award-winning Talise Spa at Jumeirah Messilah Beach features a stunning Himalayan Salt Room, the first of its kind in the Middle East, built with pure crystal salt in its natural state. The spa also comprises dedicated ladies' and men’s areas with an extensive range of treatment rooms, including two private suites.
Superior conference and banqueting facilities mark Jumeirah Messilah Beach as the perfect venue for meetings and events.
